# netcup_server_snapshot_export (Action)

Exports a snapshot of a netcup server (SCP REST API). Only offline snapshots can be exported and the server must be in state `SHUTOFF`. netcup includes one export per server, further ones are booked in the CCP.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "netcup_server_snapshot_export" "example" {
  config {
    server_id = 12345
    name      = "before-upgrade"
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the snapshot.
- `server_id` (Number) Id of the server.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `invoke` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
